verdict.rationale: Stripe publishes an official MCP server that lets AI agents interact with the Stripe API (including Issuing) via natural-language-driven tool calls, and Issuing docs explicitly discuss agent-scoped card issuance. However, the evidence doesn't show Issuing-specific natural-language command examples or independent hands-on confirmation that Issuing operations work well through the MCP server. Missing for 10: Issuing-specific NL command documentation/examples, independent/hands-on verification of MCP-driven Issuing operations.
